title: Letters of Marque
summary: The Gull Fleet is taking League ships under a commission, a letter of marque. Hester Quaile wants to know who signed it and what they paid. Admiral Hesk keeps it aboard his flagship on the Gull Isles.

steps.journal: Take the road past the salt marsh to the landing jetty on the bay's west shore. Admiral Hesk keeps the flagship's great cabin, on the dungeon's second floor.

ready: Hesk is down, and his commission was in the wardroom. Take it to Hester Quaile at the Paid Toll in Tollhaven.
done: Hesk's commission is signed Lucanus and sealed in coal-red wax with a thumbprint: the wax that pays the Redhand.
